status: static preparatory inventory; business ASGI routes inactive
verification_scope: Python3.10 AST grammar and source reading only; no application/candidate imports, suites, browser, services or RF

derivation.operations: method/path rows from baseline catalog before aliases; curated map to current dispatcher/controller functions
derivation.fields: literal get/subscript request accesses extracted by AST; known top-level fields curated per branch; local config fields extracted from allowed_local_keys set
derivation.reproduction: parse baseline catalog rows, inspect named source functions using Python ast.parse(feature_version=(3,10)); obtain ROUTE_ALIASES with ast.literal_eval; compare canonical non-template routes against AST constants; recompute file SHA256
derivation.limitations: dispatcher evidence spans multiple branches; expression/default metadata is literal source, not runtime proof. Nested or encoded contact imports, services merge, command grammar and action-specific params are not exhaustive. DTO boundary preserves values; domain validators remain controller/executor-owned.

common_semantics.router: copy body if truthy; parse_qs keep_blank_values=True; body key presence wins including null/false/empty; single query value str, repeated list; unknown fields preserved at boundary
common_semantics.normalization: strip trailing slash; apply exact alias once; HTTP uppercases method, direct router does not
common_semantics.logs_exception: parse_qs defaults keep_blank_values=False: discard empty query values, choose first remaining; ignore body; unsigned isdigit limit/offset else100/0; no bounds; system-log offset unused; reports/downloads both pagination values parsed unused
common_semantics.dto: exclude unset fields when exporting; preserve unknown fields, nested raw dicts and operation-specific coercion/order. Typed strict models cannot be applied globally without changing observed behavior
common_semantics.auth: raw path before aliases; credential fields are perimeter inputs and must not be logged

nested_services_config_validation.external_mqtt: only dict and enabled truthy: host required, optional int(port)1..65535; truthy transport tcp/websockets, auth_type anonymous/user_pass/token, privacy exact/fuzzed/hidden
nested_services_config_validation.local_mqtt: only dict and enabled truthy: optional int(port)1..65535
nested_services_config_validation.tcp_server: only dict and enabled truthy: optional int(port)1024..65535
nested_services_config_validation.passthrough: whole body forwarded reload_services; complete merge/persistence schema not asserted
